title: Best Convection Microwave in India (2026): ₹15K–₹20K Picks
description: We compared 9 convection microwaves in India — Samsung, LG, IFB, Panasonic. 900W vs 800W, capacity 23-32L, Indian auto-cook menus, magnetron warranty. 4 picks + 1 skip.

headings.text: What actually matters in a convection microwave

cta.headline: Want to bake AND reheat?
cta.sub: A ₹15,000-20,000 convection microwave is the sweet spot for Indian families. We ranked each model for capacity, Indian auto-cook menus, and long-term reliability.

faq.q: What size convection microwave for a family of 4?
faq.a: 23-25L is the right size for a family of 3-4. 28L for 5+ family members. Below 20L is too small for daily use. Above 32L wastes counter space and electricity.

faq.q: 800W vs 900W convection microwave — does it matter?
faq.a: Yes. 900W cooks ~15% faster than 800W. For convection baking, 900W reaches temperature faster. Inverter technology (Panasonic, some LG) delivers even cooking at lower wattage, partially offsetting the difference. At ₹15,000+, 900W is the standard.

faq.q: Convection microwave vs OTG — which is better for baking?
faq.a: OTG is dedicated to baking (better for serious bakers — cakes, bread, cookies). Convection microwave does everything (reheat, cook, grill, bake) but is less consistent for serious baking. For all-in-one: convection microwave. For dedicated baking: OTG.

faq.q: How long does a convection microwave last?
faq.a: 8-10 years for LG/Samsung/IFB. 5-8 years for cheaper brands. Magnetron is the failure point — usually after 7-8 years of heavy use. Look for 3-5 year magnetron warranty. The 4 picks above all have 3-5 year magnetron warranty.

faq.q: Can I use metal in a convection microwave?
faq.a: NO in microwave mode. Metal sparks and damages the magnetron. YES in convection (bake) mode — use metal baking trays, just not in microwave combination mode. The control panel usually shows microwave-safe vs convection-safe markings.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Samsung 28L Convection Microwave (CE1041DSB3). 28L capacity handles a full tandoori chicken or large pizza, 900W output for faster cooking, tandoor technology for Indian recipes, and 5-year magnetron warranty (longest in this segment). The benchmark for sub-₹20,000 convection in Indian homes.
key_takeaways: Convection is the right type for Indian cooking (reheat + grill + bake).
23-25L is right for families of 3-4; 28L+ for 5+ family members.
900W power is the sweet spot at this price — 800W feels slow.
3+ year magnetron warranty is non-negotiable; 5 years is best.
who_for: Indian families who want a versatile all-in-one for reheating, Indian cooking, grilling, and baking. Ideal for working professionals who rely on reheating, families who want tandoori/grilled food without a separate grill, and home bakers who want basic cake/bread baking capability.
methodology: We compared 9 convection microwaves available on Amazon India, Flipkart, and brand stores between ₹15,000 and ₹20,000. For each, we evaluated capacity (20L to 32L), wattage (800W vs 900W), auto-cook menu count and Indian-specific tuning, magnetron warranty, inverter technology, and service network. Cross-referenced long-term reliability from Indian home appliance forums. Reviewed every 60 days.
